justification: Tightens the PreToolUse merge guard: a merge run from inside a double-quoted commit message is now gated, and a ?sha= query in a merge URL no longer counts as a head pin.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: git commit -m "$(gh pr merge 902)" is not reported as a merge, or a ?sha= URL counts as a pin
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-29: on origin/main the new tests gave 2 failed (substitution merge not found; ?sha= accepted as pin).

pre_impl.existing_data: Sol notes on merged code, listed in ce-NEXT-PROMPT-2026-10-28 'Open review notes'.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Message stripping assumed nothing inside a quoted message runs; the pin regex assumed any sha= is a request field.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Edits two regexes and the stripping step in the existing hook.

functions.name: _keep_substitutions
functions.input: one quoted message argument matched in the shell command
functions.output: the commands inside $( ) or backticks of a double-quoted message as separate segments, else a blank
functions.if_none: no substitution gives a blank, as before

values.if_missing: an empty command yields no merges

break_it.scenario: A message merely mentions gh pr merge as text.
break_it.what_happens: An ordinary commit would be blocked.
break_it.how: Only $( ) and backtick parts are kept; plain text and single-quoted messages stay data; tests added.

break_it.scenario: A merge pinned with ?sha= in the URL.
break_it.what_happens: An unpinned merge passes as pinned.
break_it.how: Only -f/--field sha= or a JSON "sha" body count; test added.

break_it.scenario: A pin sent as a JSON body through curl -d.
break_it.what_happens: A correctly pinned merge would be refused.
break_it.how: The JSON "sha": form is matched; test added.
